reader_summary.headline: How can we evolve the web for a better future?
reader_summary.overview: How can we evolve the web for a better future? Has the web become a mature platform — or are we still in the early days of knowing what it can do and what role it might have in our lives?. Just as “social/local/mobile” once did.

key_points.text: Has the web become a mature platform — or are we still in the early days of knowing what it can do and what role it might have in our lives?.
Chris Dixon (general partner at a16z and co-lead of the a16z crypto fund) discusses all things internet with Jonah Peretti (founder and CEO of BuzzFeed)..
